Note: The above Statechart Diagram is a simplified representation and may not fully capture the complexity of a real-world Finite State Machine. In practice, additional states and transitions would be needed to handle error conditions, logging, notifications, and other operational details. The JSON test cases are designed to cover the specified requirements, with positive, negative, and boundary testing scenarios. Each test case is associated with the relevant requirement ID and is expected to produce concrete, checkable outcomes. The test suite aims to achieve 100% state coverage and transition coverage, with guard conditions tested under both True and False values. The expected results are grounded in the requirement text, and specific values not mentioned in the requirements are marked as "as specified".
